headline:
Strong uptrend,
overwhelming analyst support
chart_note: 10-day range: $481.15 - $513.53, up 5.3% over the window - down 1.2% today after a fresh high.
why_today: Down 1.2% today after touching a fresh 10-day high - price remains far above both the 50-day ($430.65) and 200-day ($431.18) averages.
pro_1: Earnings up 31.7% and revenue up 17.7% YoY - consistent double-digit growth at massive scale
pro_2: Analyst sentiment is close to unanimous: 54 of 57 ratings are Buy or Strong Buy, zero Sell
con_1: Up 9.2% in the past month alone - a lot of good news is likely already reflected in the price
con_2: Still about 8% below the 52-week high of $549.20 - worth watching whether it can reclaim that level
